tools.name: mimiq.show_report
tools.description: Show the finished result of a saved Mimiq test, or two saved tests compared: the call, counts, objections in simulated people's words, and a full report link. Use session IDs from an earlier test result or report URL. Reads your account only and spends no credits.

tools.name: mimiq.test_component
tools.description: Show a UI component (a button, card, form, modal, navigation or pricing table) to simulated people and hear whether they understand it, trust it and would use it. Provide component_html, component_text, or both. With a key, the result ends with a link to the full report in the Mimiq app.

tools.name: mimiq.ask_audience
tools.description: Ask simulated people a multiple-choice question (2 to 10 options) and get each person's pick and reasoning. Use it for naming, positioning, or which feature to build next. Each person answers on their own.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "mimiq.test_page" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "mimiq.ask_audience" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: audience, question, options, count, context, concurrency, timeout_seconds

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "mimiq.compare_urls" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mimiq.test_page, mimiq.compare_copy, mimiq.compare_urls · Public sink: mimiq.test_flow, mimiq.test_copy, mimiq.compare_copy · Destructive: mimiq.compare_urls.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mimiq.test_page, mimiq.compare_copy, mimiq.compare_urls · Public sink: mimiq.test_flow, mimiq.test_copy, mimiq.compare_copy · Destructive: mimiq.compare_urls

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
